question_by_question_review.review: Shared field parameters are separated from the spin-statistics theorem hypotheses. Nine 1D periodic momenta and one fermionic spin-mode example are explicit finite models.

External mass shells, four-momentum conservation and fixed tree transfers are checked. Loop integration and diagram sums are distinguished. No spinor amplitude or differential cross section is claimed.
Free Dirac eigenvalues and eigenvectors are checked. Equal positive rest mass and opposite charge refer to physical quantum excitations; neutral self-conjugacy is separately qualified.

Ordinary and reduced conventions are separated; rounded quiz answer 2.43 is preserved. Pair threshold is an invariant-energy necessary condition with permitted-interaction and conservation qualifications.
A declared Euclidean radial scalar example illustrates subtraction and matching. It is not presented as the QED electron self-energy.
Zero-temperature perfect-conductor idealization, signed attraction and area approximation are explicit. The shown sine factor is not the full vector EM field or a pressure mode-count approximation.
Declared rate correction and amplitude interference are separately computed; coefficient and phase are inputs. Rounded quiz answer 0.7 is preserved.
The scalar static unit-coupling Green-function model has an exponential e-fold scale, no hard range endpoint and no energy-borrowing particle trajectory. Rounded quiz answer 1 is preserved.
Schwinger one-loop anomaly and signed electron Zeeman energies are checked. No full precision prediction or literal point-particle proof is claimed.
Allowed counterterms, enough measured inputs, a permitted continuum limit and finite cutoff/order/EFT remainders are explicit.

resolved_findings.resolution: ħc is now derived from exact SI h,c,e. This was a numerical consistency issue, not a material experimental discrepancy.

static_visual_inspection.finding: The retained diagram correctly labels the bosonic spatial mode as distinct from mean field, shows E=(n+1/2)ħω, and identifies the exchange contribution as amplitude bookkeeping rather than a photographed trajectory.

limitations: Float64 arithmetic and finite chart sampling are disclosed; line interpolation is not a theorem or extra allowed discrete state.
The scalar loop is a subtraction illustration, not an interacting QED solver.
Ideal plates omit material, thermal, roughness and electrostatic measurement corrections.
The static scalar mediator model omits gauge structure, spin, screening, composite interactions and strong coupling.
The leading magnetic anomaly omits higher QED, hadronic and weak contributions.
The plotted diagram is categorical topology; emitted coordinate graphs are calibrated plots rather than photographed fields.
